title: Currency Risk Exposure Heatmap
description: Model subsidiary-level FX exposure across multi-entity corporate structure. Intercompany receivables/payables by currency, natural hedge identification, net FX exposure matrix. Client-side. Works offline. Zero PII.

^e[0-3]_(USD|EUR|GBP|JPY|CNY|BRL)$.description: Net exposure in that currency for entity slot 0-3 (receivables +, payables -)
